description: Java entity class representing a tax rate in the sales management system, including tax details, relationships to other entities, and audit information.

classes.name: TaxRate
classes.description: Entity class for tax rate details, including tax rate value, priority, code, relationships to tax class, country, zone, and parent tax rates.

methods.description: Getter for the rateText transient field.
